content: MK says Ṣāʾin al-Dīn and his circle were rewarded for their labours with the derisive label naw-mulḥidān (neo-bāṭinīs, even neo-Ismaʿilis), given them by the establishment Sufi Zayn al-Dīn Khwāfī; MK notes that Ṣāʾin al-Dīn in his R. al-Inzāliyya, written before 828/1425, already decries lettrism's unpopularity in Iran.
refers_to_primary: R. al-Inzāliyya (before 828/1425); Binbaş, Sharaf al-Dīn, 124-29 (via MK, fn 16)
